prompt: I installed the mlflow openclaw plugin into my openclaw (2026.10.5) and pointed it at my local mlflow with MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI=sqlite:///mlflow.db but nothing shows up in the UI after running openclaw agent --local. once it works I want my openclaw agent to go through the self improvement harness in this repo, with tool calls visible so I can check it actually reads the docs. how do I set that up?
assertions: The answer says the connector exports over HTTP, so MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI must point at a running mlflow server instead of sqlite:///mlflow.db.
The answer mentions the hooks.allowConversationAccess grant (or that install.sh / openclaw mlflow configure sets it) as a cause of missing traces on OpenClaw 2026.10.
The answer configures the harness with SI_AGENT=openclaw and SI_OPENCLAW_MLFLOW=1.
The answer proposes a criteria check on the tool spans (requires_tool with tool_input_match, or a grounded judge) to verify the agent read the docs.
The answer does not claim that the connector records cost, or that it writes one LLM span per model call.
